recipes.name: Oyster Mushroom Curry Salad Sandwich
instructions: Heat a medium pan over medium-high heat. Add the oil, garlic, and shallot. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes. Using your hands, peel the mushrooms into small strips, and add them to the pan along with the salt. Cook, while stirring occasionally for 3 minutes.
Add the cumin, coriander, ginger, and pepper, and cook for another 3 minutes. By now, the liquid from the mushrooms should have evaporated. Transfer the mixture to a bowl.
To the same bowl, add the pineapple, mayo, yogurt, curry powder, and mustard. Stir to combine.
To assemble the sandwich, begin with a slice of your favourite bread. Layer it with lettuce, tomato slices, the mushroom curry mixture, and top it with some green onions. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Storage The mushroom salad filling can be stored in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days.
